cohort: 580 women with obstetric fistulas presenting to the surgical mission trips of the International Organization for Women and Development (IOWD) at the National Hospital of Niamey, Niger, from October 2003 to April 2009
finding: Women presenting to the IOWD for fistula repair have specific epidemiologic characteristics, including a median age of 29 years, a mean age at marriage of 16 years, and a high proportion of prolonged labor and stillbirth.
mod_finding: Vaginal (66.3%) or cesarean (27.7%) delivery was a common predisposing factor for developing an obstetric fistula.
